typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	LoadCopyGLEOM_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		EFFECTIVE_DATE as date,
		JE_LINE_NUM as double,
		ATTRIBUTE1 as string,
		GL_AU_NBR as string,
		External_reference as string,
		riskMonth_Dte as date,
		ENTERED_DR as double,
		GMI_ACCOUNT as string,
		ENTERED_AMOUNT as double,
		ENTERED_CR as double,
		GLRECID as long,
		Record_Status as string,
		JE_HEADER_ID as double,
		GL_COMPANY_NBR as string,
		ATTRIBUTE7 as string,
		CURRENCY_CODE as string,
		GL_ACCOUNT_NBR as string,
		AMOUNT_DR as double,
		Type as string,
		AMOUNT_CR as double,
		create_dte as timestamp,
		AMOUNT as double,
		update_dte as timestamp,
		riskMonth_Adj_Dte as date
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> GetGLRecordsforEOM
GetGLRecordsforEOM sink(input(
		EFFECTIVE_DATE as date 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		JE_LINE_NUM as double,
		ATTRIBUTE1 as string,
		GL_AU_NBR as string,
		External_reference as string,
		riskMonth_Dte as date 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		ENTERED_DR as double,
		GMI_ACCOUNT as string,
		ENTERED_AMOUNT as double,
		ENTERED_CR as double,
		GLRECID as long,
		Record_Status as string,
		JE_HEADER_ID as double,
		GL_COMPANY_NBR as string,
		ATTRIBUTE7 as string,
		CURRENCY_CODE as string,
		GL_ACCOUNT_NBR as string,
		AMOUNT_DR as double,
		Type as string,
		AMOUNT_CR as double,
		create_dte as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		AMOUNT as double,
		update_dte as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		riskMonth_Adj_Dte as date 'dd-MM-yyyy'
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,batchSize: 10000,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		EFFECTIVE_DATE,
		JE_LINE_NUM,
		ATTRIBUTE1,
		GL_AU_NBR,
		External_reference,
		riskMonth_Dte,
		ENTERED_DR,
		GMI_ACCOUNT,
		ENTERED_AMOUNT,
		ENTERED_CR,
		GLRECID,
		Record_Status,
		JE_HEADER_ID,
		GL_COMPANY_NBR,
		ATTRIBUTE7,
		CURRENCY_CODE,
		GL_ACCOUNT_NBR,
		AMOUNT_DR,
		Type,
		AMOUNT_CR,
		create_dte,
		AMOUNT,
		update_dte,
		riskMonth_Adj_Dte),
	partitionFileNames:[($LoadCopyGLEOM_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> LoadCopyGLEOM
